title: The Secret Samosa Mission
custom_script:
# Scene: kitchen
Peddy: {look-around} Teddy! Come here, quickly! [surprised, wave, whisper]
Teddy: Why are we whispering? [suspicious, hips, whisper]
Peddy: {sniff} Mom made samosas. Twelve hot, crispy samosas! {love} [happy, point, excited]
Teddy: No way. Mom said they are for the guests. {shake-head} [normal, idle, calm]
Peddy: Just one. {idea} Nobody counts samosas! [happy, think, ding]
Teddy: {facepalm} Everybody counts samosas, Peddy. [sad, shrug]
Peddy: {eat} Mmm… too late. [happy, idle, eat]
Teddy: You ATE one?! {shock} [angry, point, shout, boing]
# Time skip: Ten minutes later…
# Scene: home (sitting)
Teddy: Peddy… {look-around} why is the plate empty? [suspicious, hips]
Peddy: {sweat} The cat ate them. [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Teddy: WE DON'T HAVE A CAT! {angry} [angry, point, shout, crash]
Peddy: {giggle} Then… the cat ran away? [happy, shrug, fail]
# Scene: street
Teddy: Mom is coming home! {scared} What do we do now? [surprised, wave, excited]
Peddy: {think} Simple. We buy twelve new samosas! [happy, point]
Teddy: With what money? [suspicious, hips, calm]
Peddy: {phone} Mom's wallet… is in my pocket. {sweat} [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Teddy: PEDDY! {facepalm} [angry, hips, shout, slap]
Peddy: {laugh} Run! {walk-out} [happy, wave, footsteps]
